data.title: The information panel at Pružina
data.excerpt: On 16 June 2013 members of the Hradiská civic association installed a new information panel at Pružina, below the slope of the Slavic hillfort of Mesciská, to tell walkers and cyclists on the blue trail that a short detour is worth it. Members of the Považská Bystrica archaeological club, who discovered the hillfort in the 1990s, came to support us.

children.text: On 16 June 2013 members of the Hradiská civic association installed a new information panel at Pružina, near the hamlet of Ritka (today Riedka), below the slope of
, a panel which will alert tourists travelling along the blue walking (and also cycling) route to the fact that it is worth making a short detour from the route to visit this exceptional hillfort.

We prepared thoroughly for the installation on the Saturday evening, when we arrived at the hillfort itself and set up a small Slavic settlement there. Good wine from Modra and a good mood were not to be missed.
The following day we set about the installation and the unveiling of the panel itself.
To our immense delight, we were supported on the spot by members of the now legendary archaeological club in Považská Bystrica,
Štefan Meliš, Martin Olšovský, Ladislav Janech, Gašpar Zemančík and Stanislav Miko
. It was they who discovered the hillfort in the 1990s and surveyed it. We learned a great deal of valuable information from them. Thank you for finding the time and coming to join us.

children.text: Our efforts were also supported by the mayor of the village, Michal Ušiak, who went out of his way to help us: he supplied gravel and cement and had the area where the panel was to stand mown. He also promised to reimburse the cost of producing the panel. He deserves great thanks for his approach.

In agreement with the mayor we installed the panel at a spot lying between the Mojtínsky potok stream and the blue waymarked trail. A field track leads away from the panel and will take you comfortably up to the hillfort in five minutes. We believe that this place, as well as the hillfort itself, will become a sought-after destination for walkers and for everyone interested in our glorious history.
We are looking forward to the next information panel, which we will install at Modra…
Photos: Stanislav Miko, Miroslav Bros, Sammi, Orgoň
